side_effect.what: a bare ^[Lnn] on a wiki page stops being checked the moment the page gains a second `ingested:` entry
side_effect.detail: quotes.py resolves a bare reference against the single ingested slug and refuses to guess when there are several. Adding this document's reading to 17 pages silently moved 95 previously-checked quotations into the unchecked bucket. Every reference on every page touched here was rewritten to the full `slug.md:Lnn` form, and the new pages were written that way too although they have only one source.
